metadata.title: Sanad
metadata.description: A calm peer-support community for people living with chronic conditions.

hero.title: You’re not alone on this journey.
hero.subtitle: Sanad is a calm space for people living with chronic conditions to share their stories, find others who understand, and get through the hard days together.
hero.socialProof: People sharing and listening every day.
hero.imageAlt: A woman with her eyes closed, resting peacefully among leaves under a warm sun

howItWorks.title: A little support, in your own way

checkIn.title: Check in daily
checkIn.body: Say how you’re feeling in seconds. Private by default.

share.title: Share your story
share.body: Write about a hard stretch or a small win. Others respond with I relate or Sending support.

circle.title: Find your circle
circle.body: Join communities around shared experiences and chat live with people who understand.

stories.title: Real journeys, told by the people living them.
stories.readTime: {minutes, plural, one {# min read} other {# min read}}

conversations.title: It helps to talk with someone who’s been there.
conversations.subtitle: A place to share, to listen, and to feel understood.
conversations.imageAlt: Two cups of tea on a sunlit wooden table beside a window

communities.title: Find your people
communities.subtitle: Explore welcoming communities built around shared experiences, where you can connect, learn, and feel less alone.

safety.title: A safe space comes first.
safety.subtitle: Sanad is for peer support and shared experience. It never replaces your doctor.

experience.title: Experience, not prescriptions
experience.body: Stories are personal, never medical advice.

report.title: Report and block
report.body: Step away from anything that feels wrong.

cta.title: You don’t have to do this alone.
cta.subtitle: Find understanding, one conversation at a time.

footer.label: Footer
footer.copyright: © {year} Sanad. A portfolio project by Ahmed. Not a medical service.

auth.imageAlt: Two friends sitting close on a hillside, one resting her head on the other's shoulder

penName.label: Pen name
penName.hint: Your real name can stay private.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: We couldn't reach Sanad. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.GOOGLE_FAILED: Google sign-in didn't go through. Please try again.
errors.GOOGLE_EMAIL_IN_USE: This email is already linked to a different Google account. Sign in with that account, or with your email and password.

signUp.title: Join the community
signUp.subtitle: A place to share, listen, and feel understood.
signUp.terms: By joining, you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <guidelines>Community guidelines</guidelines>.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: It's good to see you again.
signIn.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new one.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: It happens. Enter the email you joined with, and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.subtitle: If there's a Sanad account for <email>{address}</email>, a link to reset your password is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
sent.spam: Can't find it? It can take a minute, and sometimes it lands in spam.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Make it at least 12 characters. Afterwards you'll be signed out everywhere, and you can sign in with it right away.
resetPassword.label: New password

invalid.title: This link has expired
invalid.subtitle: Reset links work once, for 30 minutes. Ask for a new one and it'll be on its way right away.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: One press and your email is confirmed. That's all it takes.

done.title: Email confirmed
done.subtitle: Thank you. Your email is confirmed, and you can now take part in every part of Sanad.

invalid.title: This link has expired
invalid.subtitle: Confirmation links work once, for 24 hours. Open Sanad and choose “Send it again” in the banner at the top for a fresh one.

choosePenName.title: One last step
choosePenName.subtitle: Choose the name others in Sanad will know you by.
choosePenName.switch: Changed your mind? <link>Back to sign in</link>

app.demoBanner: You're exploring a demo, and it's deleted after 24 hours. <link>Create an account</link> to keep your space.

greeting.subtitle: Hope today brings you a little more ease.
